answer: Farming becomes a ridge bet on surviving 73 epochs of grading, and every dawn settlement recomputes the summit schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 73 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 14 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
